title: The Boy Who Refused to Accept It | Dhruva Part 1 of 2

lines.text: A king had two wives. One was loved. One was forgotten.
lines.caps: A king had *two wives. | One *loved. | One *forgotten.

lines.text: The forgotten wife had a son. His name was Dhruva.
lines.caps: The forgotten wife | had a *son. | His name was *Dhruva.

lines.text: One day, the five-year-old climbed onto his father's lap.
lines.caps: Five years old, | he climbed his | *father's lap.

lines.text: His stepmother pulled him off. You were not born from me. You have no right to that seat.
lines.caps: His stepmother | *pulled him off. | You have no *right | to that *seat.

lines.text: His father watched. And said nothing.
Dhruva ran to his mother, tears on his face.
She said: there is one seat no one can ever take from you. Find Vishnu.
lines.caps: One *seat | no one can | *take from you. | Find *Vishnu.

lines.text: The five-year-old walked into the forest. Alone.
Sage Narada found him and asked: why are you here, child?
lines.caps: Sage *Narada | found him. | Why are you *here?

lines.text: Dhruva said: I want what cannot be taken away.
lines.caps: I want what | cannot be *taken away.

lines.text: Narada tried to send him home. The boy did not move.
lines.caps: Narada tried | to send him *home. | The boy did | not *move.
